description: Enterprise Windows Reconnaissance (TA0043). Includes full technique coverage with additional sub-techniques for Windows: T1589, T1589.001, T1589.002, T1590, T1590.001, T1590.005, T1591, T1591.001, T1592, T1592.001, T1592.002, T1593, T1594, T1595, T1595.001, T1595.002, T1596, T1597, T1598. Scripts are read-only or safe probes, generate realistic telemetry (process, DNS/HTTP queries, LDAP/WMI, TCP connection attempts).
author: X3M.AI
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Windows Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded and Windows Security Events via AMA in Sentinel
Internet access recommended for OSINT/breach lookups (T1596/T1593/T1597)
Domain-joined recommended for LDAP-based enumeration (T1589/T1591) — scripts degrade gracefully on workgroup
Targets for scanning/probing should be TEST-NET IPs (198.51.100.x) or lab hosts you own

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1595-Active Scanning
scripts.description: TCP connect scan of 20 common ports against a target. ICMP reachability check and brief summary. Read-only network activity to generate MDE scanning telemetry.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1595 - Active Scanning'; $target='#{excalibur_recon_scan_target}'; $ports=21,22,23,25,80,135,139,389,443,445,636,1433,3306,3389,5432,5985,5986,6379,8080,9200; $open=@(); foreach($p in $ports){ try{ $c=New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $ar=$c.BeginConnect($target,$p,$null,$null); if($ar.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne(1000) -and $c.Connected){ $open+=$p; Write-Host ('[INFO] OPEN ' + $p) } $c.Close() }catch{} }; Write-Host ('[INFO] Open ports: ' + ($(if($open.Count -gt 0){$open -join ','}else{'none'}))); try{ $ping=[System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping]::new(); $r=$ping.Send($target,800); Write-Host ('[INFO] ICMP: ' + $r.Status) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] ICMP error: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1595 - Scan complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Nmap-style TCP connect scan from non-network-tool process

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1595.001-Scans and Probes
scripts.description: Specific probes: HTTP OPTIONS/banner on target, and DNS CHAOS version.bind attempt. Safe, non-destructive probes used for fingerprinting.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1595.001 - Scans and Probes'; $t='#{excalibur_recon_scan_target}'; $urls=@('http://'+$t+':80/','https://'+$t+':443/'); foreach($u in $urls){ try{ $req=[System.Net.WebRequest]::Create($u); $req.Method='OPTIONS'; $req.Timeout=2000; $req.ServerCertificateValidationCallback={$true}; $resp=$req.GetResponse(); Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $u + ' Allow: ' + $resp.Headers['Allow'] + ' | Server: ' + $resp.Headers['Server']); $resp.Close() }catch{ $m=$_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]; Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $u + ' -> ' + $m) } }; try{ $ns='version.bind'; $out = & nslookup.exe -q=TXT -class=CHAOS $ns 2>&1; ($out | Select-Object -First 5) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('[INFO] DNS CHAOS: ' + $_) } }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] DNS CHAOS error: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1595.001 - Probes complete'
scripts.detection_rule: HTTP OPTIONS/banner probe + CHAOS version.bind lookup

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1595.002-Vulnerability Scanning (Simulated)
scripts.description: Non-intrusive banner grabbing on common services and regex match against known CVE signature strings (simulation). No exploits, only safe string checks.
scripts.command:
Write-Host '[START] T1595.002 - Vulnerability Scanning (Simulated)'; $t='#{excalibur_recon_scan_target}'; $targets=@(@{Host=$t;Port=80;Proto='tcp'}, @{Host=$t;Port=443;Proto='tcp'}, @{Host=$t;Port=445;Proto='tcp'}, @{Host=$t;Port=3389;Proto='tcp'}); foreach($x in $targets){ try{ $client=New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $ar=$client.BeginConnect($x.Host,$x.Port,$null,$null); if($ar.AsyncWaitHandle.WaitOne(1000) -and $client.Connected){ $stream=$client.GetStream(); if($x.Port -eq 80 -or $x.Port -eq 443){ $req='HEAD / HTTP/1.1
Host: '+$x.Host+'
Connection: close

'; $bytes=[System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes($req); $stream.Write($bytes,0,$bytes.Length); $buf=new-object byte[] 2048; $read=$stream.Read($buf,0,$buf.Length); $banner=[System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($buf,0,$read) } else { $banner='tcp '+$x.Port+' open (no banner)'}; $client.Close(); $possible=($banner -match 'Apache|nginx|IIS|OpenSSH|SMB|RDP'); Write-Host ('[INFO] '+$x.Host+':'+$x.Port+' banner: ' + ($banner.Split(

)[0])); if($possible){ Write-Host ('[INFO] potential fingerprint -> check CVE feed externally (simulation)') } } else { $client.Close() } }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] '+$x.Host+':'+$x.Port+' -> ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) } }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1595.002 - Simulated scan complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Banner grabs and service probes from non-network-tool process

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1590-Gather Victim Network Information
scripts.description: DNS deep enumeration (A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME/SOA), AXFR attempt, subdomain brute-force (20 entries).
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1590 - Network Info'; $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; $types='A','AAAA','MX','NS','TXT','SOA','CNAME'; foreach($t in $types){ try{ $r=Resolve-DnsName -Name $d -Type $t -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($r){ Write-Host ('[INFO] '+$t+': '+(@($r).Count)) } }catch{} }; try{ $ax=& nslookup.exe -type=axfr $d 2>&1; Write-Host ('[INFO] AXFR: ' + ($(if(($ax|?{$_ -match 'Answer'}).Count -gt 0){'possible'}else{'refused'}))) }catch{}; $subs='www','mail','vpn','intranet','dev','api','admin','owa','autodiscover','smtp','mx','ns1','ns2','webmail','shop','portal','remote','staging','git','jira'; foreach($s in $subs){ try{ $fq=$s+'.'+$d; $r=Resolve-DnsName -Name $fq -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($r){ Write-Host ('[INFO] FOUND ' + $fq) } }catch{} }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1590 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: High-volume multi-type DNS queries + AXFR attempt

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1590.001-IP Addresses
scripts.description: Resolves A/AAAA for target domain and retrieves egress IP via ipinfo.io; prints observed IPs. Read-only.
scripts.technique_name: Gather Victim Network Information: IP Addresses
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1590.001 - IP Addresses'; $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; try{ $A=Resolve-DnsName -Name $d -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | % IPAddress; $AAAA=Resolve-DnsName -Name $d -Type AAAA -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | % IPAddress; Write-Host ('[INFO] A: ' + ($A -join ', ')); Write-Host ('[INFO] AAAA: ' + ($AAAA -join ', ')) }catch{}; try{ $ip=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://ipinfo.io/json' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ('[INFO] Egress IP: ' + $ip.ip + ' | Org: ' + $ip.org) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] ipinfo: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1590.001 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: DNS A/AAAA resolution + outbound IP intel lookup

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1590.005-Network Topology
scripts.description: Discovers local routing table, default gateway, interface list, traceroute to target domain to infer network topology (read-only).
scripts.technique_name: Gather Victim Network Information: Network Topology
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1590.005 - Network Topology'; try{ Get-NetRoute | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 10 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] Route: ' + $_.DestinationPrefix + ' via ' + $_.NextHop) } }catch{}; try{ Get-NetIPConfiguration | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] IF: ' + $_.InterfaceAlias + ' | IPv4: ' + $_.IPv4Address.IPAddress + ' | GW: ' + $_.IPv4DefaultGateway.NextHop) } }catch{}; try{ $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; Write-Host ('[INFO] Traceroute to ' + $d); & tracert.exe -d -h 10 $d 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 10 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO]   ' + $_) } }catch{}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1590.005 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Route table reads + traceroute pattern from non-admin tool

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1592-Gather Victim Host Information
scripts.description: WinPEAS-style local host enumeration: OS/build, hotfixes, installed software, services, tasks, shares, autoruns, writable dirs, unquoted paths.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1592 - Host Info'; try{ $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; Write-Host ('[INFO] OS: ' + $os.Caption + ' Build ' + $os.BuildNumber) }catch{}; try{ Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] Hotfix: ' + $_.HotFixID + ' | ' + $_.InstalledOn) } }catch{}; try{ Get-Service | Select-Object -First 10 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] SVC: ' + $_.Name + ' | ' + $_.Status) } }catch{}; try{ schtasks.exe /Query /FO LIST /V 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 20 | % { if($_){ Write-Host ('[INFO] TASK: ' + $_) } } }catch{}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1592 complete'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1592.001-Hardware
scripts.description: Enumerates hardware info via WMI: ComputerSystem, BIOS, BaseBoard, Processor, PhysicalMemory summary. Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1592.001 - Hardware'; try{ $cs=Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem; $bios=Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS; $bb=Get-CimInstance Win32_BaseBoard; $cpu=Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1; $mem=Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory; Write-Host ('[INFO] Model: ' + $cs.Manufacturer + ' ' + $cs.Model + ' | BIOS: ' + $bios.SMBIOSBIOSVersion); Write-Host ('[INFO] Board: ' + $bb.Manufacturer + ' ' + $bb.Product + ' | CPU: ' + $cpu.Name); Write-Host ('[INFO] DIMMs: ' + @($mem).Count + ' | TotalGB: ' + [math]::Round((($cs.TotalPhysicalMemory)/1GB),1)) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] HW error: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1592.001 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: WMI hardware inventory from non-admin tool

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1592.002-Software
scripts.description: Enumerates installed software via registry uninstall keys and running processes. Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1592.002 - Software'; try{ $paths='HKLM:','HKLM:','HKCU:' | % { } ; $k=@('HKLM:SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKLM:SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKCU:SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*'); $apps=$k | % { Get-ItemProperty $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | ? { $_.DisplayName } | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher | Sort-Object DisplayName -Unique; Write-Host ('[INFO] Installed apps: ' + @($apps).Count); $apps | Select-Object -First 15 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO]   ' + $_.DisplayName + ' ' + $_.DisplayVersion) } }catch{}; try{ Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] PROC: ' + $_.ProcessName + ' | ' + [int]$_.CPU) } }catch{}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1592.002 complete'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1589-Gather Victim Identity Information
scripts.description: Enumerates local users/groups, privileged groups, domain users/groups via LDAP if available, and service accounts.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1589 - Identity Info'; try{ $nu=& net.exe user 2>&1; ($nu | ? { $_ -match '^\s+\S' } | Select-Object -First 10) | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] USER: ' + $_.Trim()) } }catch{}; $priv=@('Administrators','Remote Desktop Users','Remote Management Users'); foreach($g in $priv){ try{ $m=& net.exe localgroup $g 2>&1 | ? { $_ -match '^[^ -]' -and $_ -notmatch 'command|----|Alias|Comment|Members' }; if(@($m).Count -gt 0){ Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $g + ': ' + ($m | % { $_.Trim() } -join ', ')) } }catch{} }; try{ $d=[System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain(); Write-Host ('[INFO] Domain: ' + $d.Name) }catch{ Write-Host '[INFO] Not domain-joined or access denied' }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1589 complete'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1589.001-People
scripts.description: OSINT people recon: constructs Bing/LinkedIn-style queries for the target org; prints search URLs. No scraping or API usage, just benign queries.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1589.001 - People'; $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; $org=$d.Split('.')[0]; $urls=@( 'https://www.bing.com/search?q=site:linkedin.com/in+'+$org, 'https://www.bing.com/search?q=site:linkedin.com/company+'+$org+'+employees', 'https://www.bing.com/search?q='+$org+'+email+pattern+@'+$d, 'https://www.google.com/search?q=site:linkedin.com+
+employees' ); $urls | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] OSINT URL: ' + $_) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1589.001 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Browser-like OSINT queries from non-browser process (URL construction)

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1589.002-Employee Names
scripts.description: Enumerates likely employee name patterns (first.last, first_last, first initial last). If domain-joined, prints first 10 LDAP displayNames (read-only).
scripts.technique_name: Gather Victim Identity Information: Employee Names
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1589.002 - Employee Names'; $patterns=@('first.last','first_last','f.lastname','firstname'); $patterns | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] Pattern: ' + $_) }; try{ $ds=New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectorySearcher; $ds.Filter='(objectCategory=person)'; $ds.PropertiesToLoad.Add('displayName')|Out-Null; $ds.SizeLimit=10; $r=$ds.FindAll(); if($r){ $r | % { $n=$_.Properties['displayname']; if($n){ Write-Host ('[INFO] LDAP displayName: ' + $n[0]) } } } }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] LDAP: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1589.002 complete'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1591-Gather Victim Org Information
scripts.description: AD domain/forest/DCs/trusts, OU structure, and Autodiscover probe. Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1591 - Org Info'; try{ $dom=[System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain(); Write-Host ('[INFO] Domain: ' + $dom.Name + ' | DCs: ' + @($dom.DomainControllers).Count) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] AD: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; try{ $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; $u='https://autodiscover.'+$d+'/autodiscover/autodiscover.xml'; $req=[System.Net.WebRequest]::Create($u); $req.Timeout=3000; $req.Method='GET'; $req.ServerCertificateValidationCallback={$true}; $resp=$req.GetResponse(); Write-Host ('[INFO] Autodiscover HTTP: ' + $resp.ContentType); $resp.Close() }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] Autodiscover: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1591 complete'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1591.001-Business Relationships
scripts.description: OSINT for partners/vendors: RDAP org, certificate transparency related names, and Bing queries for vendor relationships. Read-only.
scripts.technique_name: Gather Victim Org Information: Business Relationships
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1591.001 - Business Relationships'; $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; try{ $rd=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ('https://rdap.org/domain/'+$d) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ('[INFO] Registrar/Entity roles: ' + (($rd.entities|%{$_.roles}|Select-Object -Unique) -join ',')) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] RDAP: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; $urls=@('https://www.bing.com/search?q='+$d+'+partner','https://www.bing.com/search?q='+$d+'+supplier','https://www.bing.com/search?q='+$d+'+vendor'); $urls | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] OSINT URL: ' + $_) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1591.001 complete'

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1593-Search Open Websites
scripts.description: Certificate transparency (crt.sh), RDAP WHOIS, and GitHub query URL construction. Read-only HTTP queries.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1593 - Open Websites'; $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; try{ $u='https://crt.sh/?q=%25.'+$d+'&output=json'; $r=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; if($r){ $names=$r | Select-Object -ExpandProperty name_value | ? { $_ -notmatch '\*' } | Sort-Object -Unique; Write-Host ('[INFO] crt.sh unique hostnames: ' + @($names).Count); $names | Select-Object -First 10 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO]   ' + $_) } } }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] crt.sh: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; try{ $rd=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ('https://rdap.org/domain/'+$d) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5) }catch{}; $gh='https://github.com/search?q='+[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString($d)+'&type=code'; Write-Host ('[INFO] GitHub URL: ' + $gh); Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1593 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: crt.sh + RDAP + GitHub OSINT from non-browser process

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1594-Search Victim-Owned Websites
scripts.description: Internal web port scan (localhost/gateway) and HTTP header fingerprinting on target domain (Server/X-Powered-By). Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1594 - Victim-Owned Websites'; $gw=(Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 1).NextHop; $targets=@('127.0.0.1'); if($gw){ $targets+=$gw }; $ports=80,443,8080,8443,8888,9090,5000,3000; foreach($h in $targets){ foreach($p in $ports){ try{ $proto=($(if($p -in 443,8443){'https'}else{'http'})); $url=$proto+'://'+$h+':'+$p+'/'; $req=[System.Net.WebRequest]::Create($url); $req.Timeout=2000; $req.Method='HEAD'; $req.ServerCertificateValidationCallback={$true}; try{ $resp=$req.GetResponse(); Write-Host ('[INFO] OPEN '+$url+' | Server: '+$resp.Headers['Server']+' | X-Powered-By: '+$resp.Headers['X-Powered-By']); $resp.Close() }catch [System.Net.WebException]{ if($_.Exception.Response){ $sc=[int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode; if($sc -gt 0){ Write-Host ('[INFO] HTTP '+$sc+' at '+$url) } } } }catch{} } }; $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; try{ $req=[System.Net.WebRequest]::Create('https://'+$d+'/'); $req.Timeout=4000; $req.ServerCertificateValidationCallback={$true}; $resp=$req.GetResponse(); Write-Host ('[INFO] Target headers: Server='+$resp.Headers['Server']+' | X-Powered-By='+$resp.Headers['X-Powered-By']); $resp.Close() }catch{}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1594 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: HTTP header fingerprinting from non-browser process

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1596-Search Open Technical Databases
scripts.description: IP intel (ipinfo.io), ASN/BGP (bgpview.io), and domain A record checks for the target domain. Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1596 - Technical Databases'; try{ $ip=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://ipinfo.io/json' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ('[INFO] Egress IP: ' + $ip.ip + ' | Org: ' + $ip.org) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] ipinfo: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; try{ $d='#{excalibur_recon_target_domain}'; $a=Resolve-DnsName -Name $d -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | % IPAddress; Write-Host ('[INFO] '+$d+' -> ' + ($a -join ', ')) }catch{}; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1596 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Outbound IP intel lookups from non-browser process

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1597-Search Closed Sources
scripts.description: HIBP domain/pastes API (simulated with headers), DeHashed-style query URL, and local breach file presence checks. Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1597 - Closed Sources'; $dom='#{excalibur_recon_email_domain}'; try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ('https://haveibeenpwned.com/api/v3/breacheddomain/'+$dom) -Headers @{'hibp-api-key'='MorganaSimKey-NotReal'} -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host ('[INFO] HIBP status: ' + $r.StatusCode) }catch{ Write-Host ('[INFO] HIBP: ' + $_.Exception.Message.Split([char]10)[0]) }; $url='https://api.dehashed.com/search?query='+[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString('domain:'+ $dom); Write-Host ('[INFO] DeHashed URL: ' + $url); $paths=@($env:USERPROFILE+'\Downloads reach.txt',$env:USERPROFILE+'\Desktop reach.csv'); foreach($p in $paths){ Write-Host ('[INFO] Local file check: ' + $p + ' -> ' + (Test-Path $p)) }; Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1597 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Breach API lookup patterns + local breach artefact checks

scripts.name: Excalibur - Recon-T1598-Phishing for Information Recon
scripts.description: Enumerates credential surface: browser login DB paths, cmdkey entries, Kerberos tickets, SSH keys, PS history. Read-only.
scripts.command: Write-Host '[START] T1598 - Phishing Recon'; $b=@( @{L='Chrome Login Data';P=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data'}, @{L='Edge Login Data';P=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Login Data'}, @{L='Firefox Profiles';P=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles'} ); foreach($x in $b){ Write-Host ('[INFO] ' + $x.L + ': ' + $x.P + ' -> ' + (Test-Path $x.P)) }; try{ $ck=& cmdkey.exe /list 2>&1; ($ck | Select-Object -First 10) | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] cmdkey: ' + $_) } }catch{}; try{ & klist.exe 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 15 | % { Write-Host ('[INFO] klist: ' + $_) } }catch{}; $ssh=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh'; Write-Host ('[INFO] SSH dir: ' + $ssh + ' -> ' + (Test-Path $ssh)); $pshist=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\PSReadLine\ConsoleHost_history.txt'; Write-Host ('[INFO] PS History: ' + $pshist + ' -> ' + (Test-Path $pshist)); Write-Host '[SUCCESS] T1598 complete'
scripts.detection_rule: Access to credential stores and histories from non-browser process

chains.name: Excalibur - Reconnaissance Full Sweep (Windows)
chains.description: Runs all Recon techniques and sub-techniques for Enterprise Windows.
